nonPoolDecisions: Páipéar II (110) before 2012 is literature only: one whole question in prose and one in poetry, each from the prescribed course (Roinn A) or the optional course (Roinn B); each question is 55 = (a) 35 + (b) 20, both answered. Choice is not a route; no combination cards.

The scheme prints no answers: every ask restated with its price, and some prices split. Every award criterion is the restatement claimed at its printed price (or the totals its printed parts make), marked tariffOnly; each card says “The scheme prints no answer for this part.”

Language: one deduction per part where the scheme prints one (0–5 under Filíocht Ainmnithe (a) and Filíocht Roghnach (a); 0–3 under each (b)). The scheme prints none under Prós Ainmnithe (a) or Prós Roghnach (a) (its Nóta names an (a) deduction but prints no range): those cards carry no deduction criterion, and their note says so.

Cards: Prós Ainmnithe (a) a card per prescribed work (three), (b)(i) and (b)(ii) a card each (20 whole; 10 × 2); Filíocht Ainmnithe (a) a card per poem (two), (b)(i) and (b)(ii) a card each; Prós Roghnach (a) the folk tale and the short story a card each (priced differently), (b) one card carrying (i) and (ii) (9 + 9 and 9 × 2, marked alike); Filíocht Roghnach (a) a card per option (priced differently), (b)(i) and (b)(ii) a card each; and a practice card for every prescribed-course (a) sub-question (14).
caveats: Páipéar II = 110: prose 55 (Roinn A Ceist 1 or Roinn B Ceist 1) and poetry 55 (Roinn A Ceist 2 or Roinn B Ceist 2); each (a) 35 + (b) 20.

Prós Roghnach (a), short story: the scheme restates (i) as “Cuntas ar an mothúchán is láidre sa ghearrscéal = 23 marc” where the paper asks “tabhair cuntas ar na príomhimeachtaí (rudaí) a tharla sa ghearrscéal sin”. Kept as printed; the card carries a source note.

Filíocht Roghnach (a), second option: the scheme numbers the title question “(iv)” (it is the paper’s (ii)) and prices “Teideal an dáin oiriúnach? = 4 marc” + “Fáth amháin le do fhreagra = 4 marc”, where the paper asks only whether the title suits (8). The criterion carries the scheme’s prices without its misprinted number; the card carries a source note.
An Bhean Óg (a)(ii): the scheme prices the reasons “Fáth ar/nár thaitin sé leat. = 4 marc” whole, where the other two works print “Dhá fháth = 2 marc × 2”.
No language deduction is printed under Prós Ainmnithe (a) or Prós Roghnach (a) (PDF 5, 7–8); the Nóta after each prose question names the (a) deduction without a range.
Scheme misprints kept as printed: “Fáth ar/nár thaitin ?”, “ghearrrscéil”, “20marc”, “=14 marc”, “Pearsa a thaitin(nó nár thaitin)leat”.
Paper and scheme differ in wording, each kept as printed: Faoiseamh a Gheobhadsa (iv) “An maith leat an dán seo?” (the scheme: “Ar thaitin an dán leat?”).
